[Section] Experiments ::: Evaluation data
[source_id=24] Testing data VLSP 2018: This dataset contains relatively 5 hours of short audio voices with 796 samples.
[source_id=25] Testing data VLSP 2019: The testing set in 2019 is quite harder compare with the set in 2018. There are more than 17 hours with 16,214 short audio samples. The set is difficult because audio contains more noise and having more informal speaking style.
